sources.role: official ColEm 5.6 manual, options, state and EEPROM naming

paths.path: No portable persisted config path is defined in the official source; Unix input is compiled X11 keyboard handling in EMULib/Unix/LibUnix.c.
paths.naming: No portable configuration filename or hand-edited controller grammar is present in ColEm56-Source.zip.

paths.path: Unix maps X11 keyboard events directly to Coleco joystick bits; the portable source has no persisted controller mapping writer.
paths.naming: Arrow keys, Shift/Control and other X11 keys are source-defined; Windows physical joystick selection is outside the portable source.

paths.path: The cartridge directory/name-derived save path; Coleco.c derives SavName with MakeFileName(Name, ".sav") and SaveSAV writes EEPROM data.
The cartridge directory/name-derived state path; Coleco.c derives StaName with MakeFileName(Name, ".sta") and SaveSTA writes state data.
paths.naming: <cartridge-basename>.sta; F6/F7 and -state-style runtime paths are user-selected through the source menu/launch arguments.

paths.path: ColecoVision/ADAM system ROM requirements vary by machine mode; official site does not publish a single canonical filename/hash, so external firmware remains an evidence-backed gap.
paths.naming: ColecoVision/ADAM system ROM variants are machine-dependent; no single canonical filename/hash is published.

paths.path: No source-backed keys path or grammar was established for the linux host during this catalog audit.
evidence: docs:https://fms.komkon.org/ColEm/ColEm56-Source.zip (primary source cited by this record; keys capture remains unresolved for linux)

linux.notes: ColEm supports Windows/Linux/macOS native distributions; Android/iOS are outside this host matrix.
